package.description: A video annotation tool designed for sport analysis.

en-US.description: A video annotation tool designed for sport analysis.
en-US.longDescription:
Kinovea is a video annotation tool designed for sport analysis.
It features utilities to capture, slow down, compare, annotate and measure motion in videos.
Kinovea is completely free and open source.
en-US.name: Kinovea

zh-CN.description: 一款为运动分析而生的视频标注工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Kinovea 是一款为运动分析而生视频标注工具。
该软件提供视频捕捉、慢动作播放、画面比对、动作标注及运动测量等功能。
Kinovea 为完全免费/自由的开源软件。
